title: The client iPhone app opens on the client's own company and details
text: Inside the client iPhone app only (the website is unchanged), the Overview now starts with one blue company card: name, type, state, EIN with a Copy button, formation date and filing ID. The announcement cards moved behind a round News button on that card, with a red number. Anything the client must act on stays on the page. Below, the client's details are a short profile with Edit, and the Identity and Tax card is always there: with no ITIN it says so, and numbers stay hidden until the client taps Show. The four addresses are four cards with a Copy button each.
points: Open the app's Overview: the company card is first
Tap the round News button to read the announcements
Scroll to Identity and Tax: the ITIN row is there even with no ITIN
Tap Copy on the EIN or on an address
